text: 你问的太多了，我不相信你了，卫兵！！！

text: Hey! I told you were not allowed down here! Guards!
source_text: Hey! I told you were not allowed down here! Guards!

text: 嘿！我说过了你不能在这里！卫兵！
source_text: 嘿！我说过了你不能在这里！卫兵！

text: You ask too many questions. Who are you?
source_text: You ask too many questions. Who are you?

text: 你问的太多了，你是谁？
source_text: 你问的太多了，你是谁？

text: Excuse me, sister. You startled me. How may I serve the Master?
source_text: Excuse me, sister. You startled me. How may I serve the Master?

text: 对不起，教友，你吓着我了。你有什么要我帮忙的？
